input.quote: (b) NON SOLICITATION. During the Term of this Agreement and during the three year period after the expiration or termination of this Agreement, the Licensee will not solicit any person employed by Licensor and/or its Affiliates to leave his or her employment with Licensor.
input.rationale: We traced every restriction-bearing provision (Article II licence restrictions and Additional Restrictions at p0027, p0030, p0040-p0047; Article VI sub-licence bar at p0085; the restrictive-covenants article at p0124-p0125; the Change of Control and Right of First Refusal articles at p0134 and p0139; and General Provisions at p0144-p0159). None restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build: the only restrictive covenant binding us is an employee non-solicit (a NONSOLICIT matter, not flagged here), and we are nowhere barred from using, buying or building competing FX platforms or from competing with Licensor. The "Field of Use" limit (p0007, p0030) and the Derivative Work / distribution bars (p0044, p0085) are scope limits on our use of Licensor's own Licensed Technology, not a field-of-use restraint on our business, and the licence is expressly non-exclusive in both directions (p0043), so Licensor holds no exclusive right preventing us from using or licensing our own product or brand. The Change of Control consent mechanic keyed to a competitive acquirer (p0134) is a change-of-control/assignment term addressed under that rule and is not double-flagged here. The rule's preferred position - no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer - is therefore met.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
